en.headline: Police arrest 127 in operation against Vietnamese-led loan-sharking syndicate
en.dek: Officers seized more than HK$2 million after a six-month undercover probe into a group that charged daily interest of HK$100 per HK$10,000 and ran illegal gambling and bars in West Kowloon.
body: Hong Kong police have arrested 127 people in a two-day operation against a Vietnamese-led syndicate accused of running high-interest loan-sharking, illegal gambling and unlicensed bars targeting members of the local Vietnamese community in West Kowloon.

The Organised Crime and Triad Bureau said the group, led by a Vietnamese woman holding a Hong Kong identity card, charged HK$100 a day for every HK$10,000 borrowed, producing a compounded annual rate of about 3,700 per cent. When borrowers could not repay, the syndicate allegedly pressed them into joining rotating savings schemes or forced them to transport drugs to settle debts.

Police raided eight premises on 8 and 9 October, including a grocery shop and a hometown association in Sham Shui Po used as cover, the leader’s home, illegal casinos and unlicensed bars. Those arrested, 55 men and 72 women aged 23 to 92, included 10 alleged core members. Among them were 79 Hong Kong identity-card holders, 24 holding “walking papers”, 20 with two-way permits and four illegal immigrants. Officers seized more than HK$2 million in cash and valuables, tools for forging documents, gambling equipment and small quantities of drugs.

zh.headline: 警破深水埗越南裔高利貸集團 拘127人年利率達3700厘
zh.dek: 有組織罪案科經半年臥底調查後，於8日至9日行動拘捕127人，檢獲逾200萬元得益，集團以同鄉會掩飾向同鄉放貴利並經營非法賭檔及酒吧。
body: 警方有組織罪案及三合會調查科破獲一個由越南裔女子主腦的犯罪集團，於10月8日至9日在西九龍多區突擊搜查，共拘捕127人，涉嫌放高利貸、經營非法賭場及無牌酒吧等。
警方表示，集團由持有香港身份證的越南籍女子操控，向同鄉提供高利貸服務，每借出1萬元每日收取100元利息，以複息計算年利率約達3700厘。若借款人無力償還，集團會誘使他們參加銀會，或以暴力威逼甚至要求販毒抵債。
行動中警方搜查包括深水埗偽裝成雜貨舖的店舖、同鄉會、主腦住所、非法賭檔及無牌酒吧等8個處所，拘捕55男72女，年齡介乎23至92歲，包括10名主腦及骨幹成員。被捕人中79人持香港身份證、24人持行街紙、20人持雙程證及4名非法入境者。警方檢獲逾200萬元現金及財物、製造假證件工具、賭具及少量毒品。
